title: Fruit by Supergood  Lychee & Kiwi 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Fruit by Supergood Lychee and Kiwi is a delicate and aromatic fruit pairing. It features the sweet, floral, and rosy notes of exotic Lychee, perfectly offset by the sharp, tangy brightness of fresh Kiwi. This elegant blend offers a unique and refreshing taste of the tropics. With a 50% VG / 50% PG blend, this e-liquid is perfectly balanced for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. It is designed to pair flawlessly with low-wattage pod kits and starter vape kits, producing discreet vapour and exceptional flavour clarity. The nicotine salt formulation ensures a smooth throat hit and rapid satisfaction. The "Fruit" collection is the latest innovation from Supergood, a premium UK manufacturer famous for their "Butter" and "Cocktail" ranges. Moving away from heavy desserts, this range focuses on delivering the most authentic and refreshing fruit profiles imaginable. Fruit by Supergood Nic Salts are available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths. This 10ml e-liquid is TPD-compliant and features a childproof cap and tamper-evident seal.
